note: Retrieval search space for the page/component retrieval KPI. Entries with functional=true are the real pages and widgets of the WWI app (routes work). Entries with synthetic_decoy=true are invented pages a wholesale ERP would plausibly have; they do NOT exist in the app, their #/decoy/ routes do not work, and an agent must never navigate to them or claim they show data. Retrieval systems must rank on text only and must not use the functional/synthetic_decoy flags, the id prefix or the route as ranking features.

items.title: Overview
items.description: Home dashboard for order activity. Shows how many orders were created in the chosen period, how many of them still have quantities left to pick, the monthly trend of orders and the split by current customer category.

items.title: Fulfilment
items.description: Warehouse view of ordered goods still waiting to be picked. Shows the stored unpicked quantity, the items with the most unpicked units, and how many created orders have finished or not finished picking.
widgets: Picking status of created orders chart

items.title: Supply
items.description: Inventory and inbound purchasing view. Compares quantity on hand with each item's reorder level and shows purchase quantities still to be received, broken down by the supplier on the purchase order.
widgets: Incoming units by actual supplier chart
Stored holdings versus reorder level chart

items.title: Analysis
items.description: Flexible breakdown page for orders, ordered units, unpicked units, incoming units, invoiced sales excluding tax and recorded gross line profit. Any of these can be grouped by month, customer, category, buying group, state, sales territory, salesperson, item, supplier or stock group, and compared with an earlier period.

items.title: Customer record
items.description: Single customer account with its stored attributes and the orders it placed in the retained period.
widgets: Customer orders in the retained period table

items.title: Order record
items.description: One sales order with all its lines: item, order date, expected delivery date, quantity ordered, quantity picked, remaining units and any backorder it created.

items.title: Order line record
items.description: One order line with item, ordered and picked quantity, remaining units and when picking of the line was completed.

items.title: Stock item record
items.description: One stock item with its nominated supplier, pack size, quantity on hand and reorder level, plus related purchase lines still to be received. A button shows all historical purchases for the item.

items.title: Purchase order record
items.description: One purchase order to a supplier with its lines, ordered and received outers, pack conversion and remaining units.

items.title: Purchase order line record
items.description: One purchase order line with ordered and received outers, last receipt date, expected delivery date and whether the line is finalised.

items.title: Supplier record
items.description: One supplier with its stored details and the purchase lines from that supplier that are still open for receipt.

items.title: Orders created card
items.description: Metric card counting distinct orders created in the selected period and scope, backorders included.

items.title: Orders with unpicked quantities card

items.title: Monthly orders created chart
items.description: Line chart of orders created per calendar month, with partial months flagged.

items.title: Orders by customer category chart
items.description: Bar chart of orders created in the period split by each customer's current category, such as novelty shop, supermarket or gift store.

items.title: Contributing orders table
items.description: Paged table of the individual orders that make up the overview figures, with links to each order and customer.

items.title: Stored unpicked quantity card
items.description: Metric card adding up ordered units not yet picked in the stored state. It is a count of item units, not money or volume.

items.title: Items with unpicked quantities chart
items.description: Ranked bar chart of stock items by unpicked units, largest first, linking to each item.

items.title: Picking status of created orders chart
items.description: Bar chart splitting created orders into picking complete and picking incomplete, with buttons to list each group's lines.

items.title: Unpicked evidence lines table

items.title: Stored holdings versus reorder level chart

items.title: Incoming units by actual supplier chart
items.description: Ranked bar chart of units still to be received on open purchase orders, grouped by the supplier on the purchase order.

items.title: Related incoming quantity card

items.title: Incoming purchase lines table

items.title: Analysis total cards

items.title: Analysis breakdown chart

items.title: Analysis change table

items.title: Customer orders table

items.title: Item related incoming purchasing table

items.title: Ticket detail
items.description: One support ticket with conversation history, linked order and resolution.

items.title: Log a support ticket
items.description: Create a new customer service ticket and link it to an order or item.

items.title: Support SLA policies
items.description: First-response and resolution time targets for tickets by priority and customer tier.

items.title: SLA breach report
items.description: Tickets that missed their response or resolution target, by team and reason.

items.title: Knowledge base articles
items.description: How-to articles and product information used by customer service agents.

items.title: Callback requests
items.description: Customers who asked to be called back, with preferred time.

items.title: Product warranty claims
items.description: Claims for faulty electronic novelty items under warranty, with supplier recovery status.

items.title: Escalated cases board
items.description: High-priority tickets escalated to supervisors, with age and next action.

items.title: Support team dashboard
items.description: Open tickets, average handling time and satisfaction for the customer service team.

items.title: Canned email responses
items.description: Reusable email replies for common customer questions.

items.title: Product safety recalls
items.description: Recalls of unsafe items, affected customers and recovery progress.

items.title: User accounts
items.description: Application users with login status, last sign-in and assigned roles.

items.title: Roles and permissions
items.description: Define roles and which pages, actions and data each role can access.

items.title: Audit log
items.description: Record of who changed what and when across the application.

items.title: Integrations hub
items.description: Connections to the accounting package, carrier systems, EDI provider and email service.

items.title: API keys
items.description: Create and revoke API keys for external systems.

items.title: Company profile settings
items.description: Company name, address, logo and trading details printed on documents.

items.title: Fiscal calendar settings
items.description: Financial year start, accounting periods and public holidays used across the application.

items.title: Document numbering sequences
items.description: Prefixes and next numbers for orders, invoices, purchase orders and credit notes.

items.title: Email templates
items.description: Templates for system emails such as invoices, statements and reminders.

items.title: Notification and alert rules
items.description: Set up email or in-app alerts, for example when an item drops below its reorder level or a large order arrives.

items.title: Scheduled report subscriptions
items.description: Have reports emailed automatically every day, week or month to chosen recipients.

items.title: Data import wizard
items.description: Upload spreadsheets to bulk load customers, items or prices.

items.title: Data export jobs
items.description: Exports of application data to CSV or Excel, with download links.

items.title: Backup and restore
items.description: Backup schedule and restore points for the application database.

items.title: Single sign-on settings
items.description: Identity provider configuration for staff sign-in.

items.title: Approval workflow builder
items.description: Design approval steps for purchase orders, credit notes and price overrides.

items.title: Custom fields designer
items.description: Add extra fields to customers, items, orders and suppliers.

items.title: Page and dashboard builder
items.description: No-code designer to add pages, place widgets and configure navigation menus.

items.title: Home dashboard layout
items.description: Choose which tiles appear on each user's home screen and in what order.

items.title: System health monitor
items.description: Background jobs, integration errors and response times for the application.

items.title: Printer and label setup
items.description: Printers for invoices, pick lists and labels at each workstation.

items.title: Regional settings and time zones
items.description: Time zone, date format, number format and currency display for the company.

items.title: Data retention policies
items.description: How long records such as audit logs and closed tickets are kept before archiving.

items.title: Monthly order volume forecast
items.description: Statistical forecast of orders per month for the next twelve months, with confidence bands, used for staffing and buying.

items.title: Item demand forecast
items.description: Twelve-week forecast of units demanded per stock item, feeding replenishment proposals.

items.title: ABC inventory classification
items.description: Ranks stock items into A, B and C classes by annual sales value and pick frequency.

items.title: Inventory turnover report
items.description: How many times stock turns over a year and days of cover, by stock group and item.

items.title: Stock-out history
items.description: Days on which each item had zero stock and the orders affected during those days.

items.title: Order fill rate report
items.description: Percentage of ordered lines and units shipped complete on the first delivery, by customer and item.

items.title: Backorder ageing report
items.description: Open backorders grouped by how many days they have been waiting, with value at risk.

items.title: Customer profitability after cost-to-serve
items.description: Net contribution of each customer after freight, returns, rebates and service costs are deducted from gross margin.

items.title: Price change impact report
items.description: Effect of last price increase on units sold and revenue by stock group.

items.title: Discount leakage report
items.description: Discounts given outside agreed rules, by salesperson and customer.

items.title: Returns rate by product
items.description: Share of units sold that were returned, by item and supplier, with top return reasons.

items.title: Customer cohort retention
items.description: Share of customers acquired in each quarter who are still ordering in later quarters.

items.title: Customer RFM scoring
items.description: Recency, frequency and monetary scores for each customer account.

items.title: Product affinity report
items.description: Items frequently bought together on the same order, for cross-selling.

items.title: Seasonal sales index
items.description: Seasonality index per stock group computed from several years of history, for planning ranges.

items.title: Lost sales and unfulfilled demand
items.description: Estimated sales lost when customers cancelled or reduced orders because items were out of stock.

items.title: Supplier spend analysis
items.description: Money spent with each supplier per year from supplier invoices, with spend concentration.

items.title: Import duty summary
items.description: Customs duty paid on imports by supplier country and tariff code.

items.title: Freight cost per order
items.description: Average delivery cost per customer order by month and delivery zone.

items.title: Quote conversion rate
items.description: Share of quotes that turned into orders, by salesperson and customer category.

items.title: Sales rep activity report
items.description: Calls, visits and quotes made by each salesperson per week.

items.title: Territory call coverage
items.description: Share of active accounts in each territory visited by a salesperson in the last 90 days.

items.title: Credit exposure by buying group
items.description: Total outstanding balance and credit limit used across members of each buying group.

items.title: Days sales outstanding trend
items.description: Monthly trend of how long customers take to pay.

items.title: Board monthly management pack
items.description: Monthly PDF pack for the board combining financial statements, KPIs and commentary.

items.title: Company KPI scorecard
items.description: Balanced scorecard of agreed company targets across finance, customers, operations and people.

items.title: Warehouse capacity utilisation
items.description: Percentage of pallet and bin positions occupied by zone, with forecast peak-season space.

items.title: Inventory shrinkage report
items.description: Stock lost to theft, damage and unexplained count variances, by zone and stock group.

items.title: Negative stock exceptions
items.description: Items showing negative quantity on hand because of posting errors, for correction.

items.title: Price list compliance audit
items.description: Invoices where the charged price differed from the customer's price list.

items.title: Report library
items.description: Catalogue of saved printable reports with owner and last run date.

items.title: Custom report designer
items.description: Drag-and-drop designer for building new printable report layouts with headers, logos and page breaks.
